description:
**Experience Luxury on the Water:** Rent a 50ft Yacht with Captain, Ice, Bluetooth Speakers, and Cooler Included!

Indulge in an unforgettable day of luxury and relaxation aboard our stunning 50ft yacht, available for private charters. Perfect for groups of up to 13, this yacht offers ample space and amenities to ensure a memorable experience on the water.
what_is_included:
- **Spacious and Luxurious Yacht:** Enjoy the comfort and elegance of our well-maintained 50ft yacht, featuring spacious deck, comfortable seating, cabins, and great sound system

- **Experienced Captain:** Our skilled and friendly captain will ensure a safe and enjoyable journey, navigating you to the best spots and catering to your needs.

- **Ice:** Stay refreshed throughout your trip with plenty of ice provided for your beverages.

- **Bluetooth Speakers:** Set the mood and enjoy your favorite tunes with our onboard Bluetooth speakers. Connect your device and create the perfect soundtrack for your day on the water.

- **Cooler for Drinks and Food:** Keep your refreshments chilled and easily accessible with our provided cooler. Bring your own snacks and drinks, or we can arrange catering (ask us about add-ons).


We also offer Jet Ski Rental & Jet Car Deliveries to the boat to enhance your experience.
highlights:
- **Private Parties:** Celebrate birthdays, anniversaries, or any special occasion in style.
- **Family Outings:** Create lasting memories with your loved ones on a fun-filled day at sea.
- **Corporate Events:** Impress your clients or reward your employees with a unique and luxurious experience.
- **Relaxing Getaways:** Escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and unwind in the serene surroundings of the open water.
extras:
- Flexible Rental Options: Choose from half-day, full-day, or multi-day charters to suit your schedule and preferences.
- Customizable Itineraries: We can work with you to create a personalized itinerary that meets your specific needs and interests.
- Catering Options: We can arrange for catering services to provide delicious meals and beverages onboard, or you are welcome to bring your own
